Name: Uncanny Valley
Author: Briman52262
Description:
Note: This mod is in a beta state. As such, it's advised to make a backup of your save before playing.[url=https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1qwhBzKgN_qEvcXViB1bplTQ97wk-gJeS?usp=sharing]

Documentation
[/url][url=https://github.com/jasisco5/UncannyValleyMod]GitHub[/url]

Meet two new characters as you explore a new location, learning the secrets hidden within the old mansion.

Location:
[list]
[*]Following the minecart tracks to the right of Clint's workshop will bring you to an old abandoned mansion. Explore, fight monsters, and uncover the secrets as you play through. But be careful, you may be in for more than you can handle.
[/list]
Characters:
[list]
[*]Butler: The late butler of the old mansion. He doesn't seem to realize that his time has passed.
[*]Apprentice: The young apprentice of the Wizard. They've got an interest in the paranormal, bringing them to the mansion.
[/list]

[/list]﻿
[i]This mod was created as a team project for a game modding class within The School of Interactive Games and Media (IGM) at Rochester Institute of Technology in Rochester NY. IGM provides an educational environment that supports and encourages creative and collaborative academic inquiry by both faculty and students. IGM’s programs,  coursework, research, and development efforts provide students with the knowledge and skills to pursue meaningful  and rewarding careers in media-centric, interactive software development, while simultaneously advancing the field and helping to provide a well-rounded educational experience.
